title: County Boards of Education – Bullying, Harassment, or Intimidation – Information Collection and Reporting Requirements
material_provisions: Bullying report forms must identify motivating personal characteristics
County boards must report incidents motivated by personal characteristics under certain conditions
State Department of Education must establish standards by July 1, 2027
County boards make disaggregated data available on request (not posted publicly)
Privacy protection: no information identifying individual students may be published
Committee name changed from 'Education, Health, and Environmental Affairs' to 'Education, Energy, and the Environment'

adopted_amendments.change: Added requirement to identify personal characteristics believed to be motivating factors
adopted_amendments.significance: New data collection requirement on reporting forms

adopted_amendments.change: Added conditional reporting requirement based on substantial increases, decreases, or disproportionate rates
adopted_amendments.significance: New reporting trigger for group-specific incidents

adopted_amendments.change: Requires Department to establish standards by July 1, 2027
adopted_amendments.significance: Creates new deadline and regulatory requirement

adopted_amendments.significance: Changes from public posting to request-based disclosure

adopted_amendments.change: Added explicit prohibition on publishing information that could identify individual students

adopted_amendments.amended: Senate Education, Energy, and the Environment Committee
adopted_amendments.significance: Updates committee name to reflect reorganization

required_facts: Report forms must identify motivating personal characteristics
County boards report incidents motivated by personal characteristics
Three triggers: substantial increase, substantial decrease, or disproportionate rate
Information made available on request (not posted publicly)
Data disaggregated by motivating personal characteristic
Privacy protection: no individual student identification allowed
prohibited_claims: Information must be posted publicly on website (WRONG - changed to available on request)
All incidents must be reported (WRONG - only those meeting specific conditions)
Applies to private schools (WRONG - county boards/public schools only)
Standards already exist (WRONG - must be established by July 1, 2027)
Individual student data can be published (WRONG - explicitly prohibited)
Committee is still 'Education, Health, and Environmental Affairs' (WRONG - name changed)

critical_distinctions.privacy_protection: Explicit prohibition on publishing information identifying individual students
